title: contracts/web.json
description: The app's web target for web-support's checkers. Present only when the app ships a web build (app.config.ts platforms includes web, or react-dom is installed and platforms is not set).

output.description: Equal to app.config.ts web.output. static (the default on EAS Hosting): every route rendered to HTML at export time in Node, and _expo/.routes.json carries the expo-router plugin's headers. single: one index.html, no code runs in Node, no routes manifest (use it on a static host whose headers file sends the isolation headers). server: rendered per request by a deployed server.

host.description: Where the deployed site gets its response headers. eas-hosting: the expo-router config plugin's headers option. static-host: a headers file the host reads (headersFile, default public/_headers for Netlify and Cloudflare Pages). custom-server: the server's own configuration file (headersFile).

headersFile.description: Repo-relative file that sets the deployed response headers for static-host or custom-server.

smokeRoutes.description: Pages check-web-export.mjs opens: each must exist in the export and, with --browser, render the testID with no console error and no uncaught exception.

smokeLanguage.description: Optional: a right-to-left (or any second) language the browser smoke opens the first smoke route in, with Chrome started as --lang=<lang>. The page must show its testID with <html dir> equal to dir and <html lang> starting with lang. Leave it out when the app has only one language.

clientRoutes.description: Dynamic route ids ('(app)/tasks/[id]') a static export serves through the host's rewrite instead of generateStaticParams.

publishSourceMaps.description: true only when the deployed site is meant to serve .map files; source maps belong to the crash reporter, not the public site.

nativeOnlyPackages.description: Packages the app knows fail in a browser and the support table does not list: check-web-support fails a web-bundled import of any of them.
